data.name: Debate Club
data.description: A handy club made of fine steel. The most persuasive line of reasoning in any debater's arsenal.

upgrade.0: After using an Elemental Skill, on hit, Normal and Charged Attacks deal additional DMG equal to <color=#99FFFFFF>60%</color> of ATK in a small AoE. Effect lasts 15s. DMG can only occur once every 3s.
